facts.label: Discount eligibility
facts.text: GEICO lists discounts including multi-policy and qualifying memberships or affiliations. Discounts and coverage vary by state and GEICO company; a single percentage is not a universal savings estimate.

facts.label: Home bundling
facts.text: Home and other listed non-auto products are arranged through GEICO Insurance Agency with non-affiliated insurers. Confirm which company issues each bundled policy.

facts.label: Mechanical breakdown
facts.text: Optional mechanical-breakdown insurance has vehicle-age, mileage and ownership requirements. GEICO generally requires a new vehicle under 15 months and 15,000 miles with the first titleholder; some states use different limits. Availability varies.
